components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. The
            effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied
            or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday before it is stored.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. When true, permits creating this owner even
            though another owner already has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that deliberately share a
                household (same lastName and address, created with sharesHousehold true). Owners in
                the same household carry the same value; owners with a unique household have none.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier, derived at read time. 'SILVER' when
                namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: SILVER
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time from the city using the pinned
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the `bulkSignupWarning` rule for `POST /api/owners`: when more than 80 owners have already been created for the request's registration business day, the created owner carries `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`. The flag is evaluated and fixed at creation, stored on the owner, and returned unchanged on later reads (matching how `getOwner` is used in the test).

Following the existing OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, I:

- **`AssignBulkSignupWarning.java`** (new pipeline function) — counts existing owners registered on the owner's resolved business day (the same per-day bucket `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit` uses) and stamps `bulkSignupWarning = count > 80` onto the built owner in place, before it is saved (so it excludes itself).
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step in after `registrationDate` (so `registrationDate` is already business-day-adjusted) and before `customerCode`, under the same `transaction` governance.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` `Boolean` field (`bulk_signup_warning` column) with getter/setter.
- **schema.sql** for all four DBs (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `bulk_signup_warning` column; the test profile uses `ddl-auto=none`, so the hsqldb schema is authoritative.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it (MapStruct maps it by name automatically).
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added `bulkSignupWarning` to the ignored targets on the request-DTO→entity mapping, consistent with the other server-computed fields.

Full suite: **33 tests, 0 failures**.
